description: Wire the GCN through every pipeline seam that today only knows gru/transformer: training, serving forward adapter, ONNX export, and threshold picking. Depends on FEAT-001 (the GCN modules, build_graph_features, and the shared permute_for_graph must already exist). Implements design sections 6 (serving), 4 (ONNX export branch), 7.2 (train.py + dataset.py + --official-split). All four paths reuse the SINGLE permute_for_graph from FEAT-001 so the axis order [*,T,27,2]<->[*,2,T,27] can never drift. The existing vector GRU/Transformer path and all 48 tests stay green.
steps: training/train.py: add 'decoupled_gcn'/'st_gcn' to build_arch (calling build_decoupled_gcn/build_st_gcn) and to the --arch choices list; apply permute_for_graph right after x.to(device) in BOTH the train loop and evaluate(), gated on arch in {'decoupled_gcn','st_gcn'}; add a required-when-official --official-split flag with NO default — when set, point gather_items at features/train ONLY, carve the VAL slice from TRAIN via per-class stratified_split, and never read features/test; when unset keep current single-tree random behavior unchanged.
training/dataset.py: correct the docstring to note group_split is unimplemented and the official CSV split supersedes it (loader is already feature-shape-agnostic; no code change to __getitem__).

server/app/recognizer.py::load_bundle: dispatch 'decoupled_gcn'->build_decoupled_gcn and 'st_gcn'->build_st_gcn; read optional top-level manifest key 'feature_kind' (default 'vector') and pass it to RecognizerBundle. Old arch names stay valid.

core/signtalk_core/recognize.py: add feature_kind: str = 'vector' to RecognizerBundle (and update its docstring to document that graph members accept [B,2,T,27]); add _graph_model_probs_over_views(model, views, temperature, device) that stacks views to [V,T,27,2], applies the shared permute_for_graph -> [V,2,T,27], then model(batch) (temperature + per-view top1 identical to the vector helper); branch recognize_clip on bundle.feature_kind ('graph' -> build_tta_graph_views + _graph_model_probs_over_views, else existing vector path). The no-bundle Phase-1 fallback stays on the vector path.
core/signtalk_core/tta.py: add build_tta_graph_views(seq, cfg) reusing the SAME trim logic as build_tta_feature_views but calling build_graph_features per view (returns [T,27,2] views).

training/export_onnx.py: add 'decoupled_gcn'/'st_gcn' to --arch; branch _load to the GCN factories (do NOT call feature_dim() for GCN); build dummy = permute_for_graph(torch.randn(1, args.seq_len, 27, 2)) (= [1,2,seq_len,27]); set dynamic_axes={'features':{0:'batch',2:'time'},'logits':{0:'batch'}}; keep the existing PyTorch<->ONNX parity assertion (non-zero exit on mismatch).

tools/pick_thresholds.py: add 'decoupled_gcn'/'st_gcn' to _build_members; in _fused_val_probs feed graph .npz as [1,2,T,27] via the shared permute_for_graph; on the official-split path read the VAL slice carved from the TRAIN tree only (never stratified_split over a combined train+test set).

Add tests: core/tests/test_official_split_guard.py (with --official-split set, gather_items is invoked against the TRAIN tree path only and stratified_split receives TRAIN-tree items exclusively; features/test paths never appear in the fit/VAL set); server/tests/test_recognize_graph.py (a RecognizerBundle with feature_kind='graph' and a fake graph nn.Module produces a valid Section 6.1 dict through recognize_clip); core/tests/test_onnx_parity_gcn.py (export a tiny random-init GCN, ONNX Runtime output matches PyTorch within atol); core/tests/test_pick_thresholds_graph.py (a fake graph member runs through _fused_val_probs with [1,2,T,27] and returns fused probs of the right shape).
acceptance_criteria: Running `c:\Users\ABHIMAN KUMAR\Documents\GitHub\Signtalk-AI\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest core/tests server/tests -q` passes ALL tests including the 4 new ones AND the 48 pre-existing ones.
A manifest with 'feature_kind':'graph' and decoupled_gcn/st_gcn members loads via load_bundle and recognize_clip returns a shape-correct 6.1 dict.
export_onnx.py --arch decoupled_gcn exports and passes the PyTorch<->ONNX parity check.
The --official-split leakage guard test proves stratified_split never sees features/test items.
The vector gru/transformer path is unchanged (old manifests with no feature_kind still work).

findings:
IMPLEMENTED (branch feat/gcn-recognizer). The GCN is wired through every seam that previously only knew gru/transformer. Exact names/paths for later features:

SHARED PERMUTE: all four paths import the SINGLE helper `from signtalk_core.graph_features import permute_for_graph` (FEAT-001). No second permute exists.
GRAPH ARCH NAMES everywhere = 'decoupled_gcn' / 'st_gcn' (strings). Graph feature_kind value = 'graph' (default 'vector').

- training/train.py: build_arch now dispatches decoupled_gcn->build_decoupled_gcn, st_gcn->build_st_gcn; --arch choices extended to [gru,transformer,decoupled_gcn,st_gcn]. Module constant `_GRAPH_ARCHS = {'decoupled_gcn','st_gcn'}`; `graph = args.arch in _GRAPH_ARCHS`. permute_for_graph applied right after `x = x.to(device)` in BOTH the train loop (gated on `graph`) and in evaluate() (new `graph: bool=False` param). New flag `--official-split` (action='store_true', NO default): when set, gather_items is called as `gather_items(args.processed_dir, label_map, split='train')` (TRAIN tree only), VAL carved from TRAIN via stratified_split; features/test NEVER globbed. When unset, legacy single-tree random path unchanged.

- training/dataset.py: gather_items gained an optional 3rd arg `split: str|None=None` — None=legacy `features/<label>/*.npz`; 'train'/'test' => `features/<split>/<label>/*.npz` (official two-tree layout). FeatureDataset.__getitem__ UNCHANGED (shape-agnostic, carries [T,27,2]). Module + stratified_split docstrings corrected: group_split is UNIMPLEMENTED; official two-tree split supersedes it.

- server/app/recognizer.py::load_bundle: dispatches decoupled_gcn->build_decoupled_gcn, st_gcn->build_st_gcn (old archs still valid). Reads optional top-level manifest key `feature_kind` (default 'vector') and passes it to RecognizerBundle(..., feature_kind=feature_kind).

- core/signtalk_core/recognize.py: RecognizerBundle gained field `feature_kind: str = 'vector'` (last field; docstring documents graph members accept [B,2,T,27]). New `_graph_model_probs_over_views(model, views, temperature, device)`: stacks views -> [V,T,27,2], permute_for_graph -> [V,2,T,27], model(batch); temperature + per-view top1 identical to vector helper. recognize_clip branches on `bundle.feature_kind=='graph'` -> build_tta_graph_views + _graph_model_probs_over_views; else vector path. The no-bundle Phase-1 fallback stays on the vector path (uses the vector views built above).

- core/signtalk_core/tta.py: new `build_tta_graph_views(seq, cfg)` — SAME trim logic as build_tta_feature_views but calls build_graph_features per view (returns [T,27,2] views).

- training/export_onnx.py: --arch extended to the 4 names; `_load` branches to DecoupledGCN/STGCN (classes, not factories — bare state_dict load) and does NOT call feature_dim() for GCN; `_GRAPH_ARCHS` constant; for graph archs dummy = permute_for_graph(torch.randn(1, seq_len, 27, 2)) = [1,2,seq_len,27] with dynamic_axes={'features':{0:'batch',2:'time'},'logits':{0:'batch'}}; vector branch keeps {0:'batch',1:'time'}. Existing PyTorch<->ONNX parity assert (non-zero exit) kept.

- tools/pick_thresholds.py: _build_members dispatches the 2 GCN archs (build_decoupled_gcn/build_st_gcn). `_fused_val_probs(members, items, device, graph=False)` — when graph, feeds each [T,27,2] npz as [1,2,T,27] via permute_for_graph. main() reads `graph = manifest.get('feature_kind','vector')=='graph'` and adds `--official-split` which gathers `split='train'` only (VAL carved from TRAIN; features/test never read).

NEW TESTS (5 across 4 files):
- core/tests/test_official_split_guard.py (2 tests): spies on training.train.stratified_split; proves with --official-split only the 4 features/train clips reach stratified_split and no features/test path leaks; and the legacy single-tree path without the flag.
- server/tests/test_recognize_graph.py (1): feature_kind='graph' RecognizerBundle + fake graph nn.Module (asserts [B,2,T,27]) through recognize_clip -> valid 6.1 dict. Stubs signtalk_core.recognize.extract_landmarks with a moving, hand-visible seq so the quality gate passes.
- core/tests/test_onnx_parity_gcn.py (1): exports a tiny random-init DecoupledGCN via export_onnx.main and checks ORT==PyTorch. NOTE: GCN parity atol used = 1e-2 (random-init BatchNorm running stats make float accumulation looser than the vector 1e-4; observed max_diff ~2.5e-3). Uses pytest.importorskip('onnxruntime').
- core/tests/test_pick_thresholds_graph.py (1): fake graph member through _fused_val_probs(..., graph=True) with [1,2,T,27] -> fused probs shape [N,C], rows sum to 1.
